artworks.title: Dawn in the Land of the Buttes
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a desert landscape with rock formations in the background. The view is from a slightly elevated point, with barren ground stretching out. The rock formations are solid and angular, standing prominently against the sky. The brushstrokes are precise, creating clean lines that define the rocks. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving a warm feeling to the scene. Sparse vegetation is visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Superstition Mountain, Apache Trail, Arizona (no.1)
artworks.medium: etching in greenish-black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons

artworks.title: Road to Paradise Valley, Arizona
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons

artworks.title: Summer Cloud, Apache Trail, Arizona
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint in greenish-black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image is a landscape depicting a rocky terrain with small bushes or shrubs. A tree with dense leaves stands on the right, with a plain leading to mountains in the distance. The sky above has billowy clouds, with a monochrome color palette creating depth and mood.

artworks.title: The First Snow (no.2)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a snowy landscape with a group of bare trees. The trees stand out against the light background, creating a contrast. The intricate network of branches is visible. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes that add texture. The color palette is black and white, emphasizing the winter setting. Shadows on the ground lead towards the trees. In the distance, some sparse vegetation can be seen.

artworks.title: Misty Day, Paul's Wharf, London
artworks.medium: drypoint in greenish-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a river or harbor with boats in the foreground and a cityscape in the background. St. Paul's Cathedral is prominently featured among other buildings slightly to the right of center. The scene is depicted with delicate etching techniques, creating a sense of falling mist or rain. The color palette is primarily grayscale, adding to the moody atmosphere. The water reflects the shapes of the boats above, contrasting with the lighter sky and buildings.

artworks.title: Coast at Monterey, California
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in greenish-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a view from above a rocky landscape, with a tall tree as the focal point. The horizon is where the sky meets water, creating a sense of vast space. The artwork uses detailed lines to create texture and depth, notably in the tree's branches and foliage. The sky features diagonal lines and swirling strokes for clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white for contrast and detail, giving the image a dramatic and timeless feel.

artworks.title: Whirlwinds, Dead Mountains, Mojave Desert, California
artworks.medium: drypoint in green on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 20.1 x 25.4 cm (7 15/16 x 10 in.)
sheet: 28 x 33 cm (11 x 13 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image features a desert landscape depicted in shades of gray and black. Two whirlwinds are shown spinning in the center, with delicate swirling lines indicating their movement. A low horizon divides the land from the sky, which includes a rugged mountain range in the background. The desert floor close to the viewer is sparsely vegetated, with rocks scattered around. The artwork appears to use fine brushstrokes or crosshatching to create texture, especially in the mountains and whirlwinds. The limited black palette gives the image a stark visual impact.

artworks.title: The Edge of the Desert, Arizona
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in greenish-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring a rugged, rocky terrain. In the background, tall mesas rise against a sky filled with textured clouds. The horizon is elevated in the upper third of the image. Dark, detailed trees with thick foliage frame the foreground. On the right, a steep cliff with angular formations contrasts with the trees. The art style includes fine brushwork and cross-hatching for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to depict light and shadow.

artworks.title: A Mirage, Arizona
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a desert landscape with a low viewpoint. The terrain stretches into the distance with jagged mountain peaks dominating the high horizon. Close plants and desert vegetation are detailed with strokes contrasting against the sand and rock. The etched technique showcases depth and texture, with a monochromatic color palette of black, white, and gray. The transition from vegetation to mountains adds to the vastness of the scene.

artworks.title: Sketch on Apache Trail, Arizona
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with steep cliffs and a canyon. A flat-topped hill is visible on the horizon, along with intricate line work detailing rocky textures and clouds in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, creating depth. Two cacti and a tree are depicted in the foreground. The ridges in the distance guide the eye towards the plateau, and light and shadow play on the cliffs.

artworks.title: The Etcher
artworks.medium: drypoint in greenish-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image features a man from the waist up, leaning forward with both arms extended as if focused on a task. He has a defined facial structure with glasses, short hair, and is wearing a light-colored shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a dark waistcoat. The background is a textured surface with vertical lines.

artworks.title: Whirlwinds, Mojave Desert, California (no.3)
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint in greenish-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a desert landscape with sparse vegetation scattered close to us. A range of rugged mountains is situated at the horizon. Dust devils or whirlwinds are rising into the sky both in the distance and just above the mountain peaks. The brushwork is fine and subtle, with delicate lines and shading creating a smooth transition from the land to the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of gray. The overall composition gives the landscape a serene yet dynamic appearance with its gentle depiction of natural elements.

artworks.title: Arizona Night
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint in green on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons

artworks.title: Mesa Encantada, New Mexico (no. 2)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a large, flat-topped rock formation in the center, with a low horizon and flat land stretching out towards it. The sky above is filled with swirling clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, grey, and off-white. Low bushes and shrubbery can be seen in the foreground, leading towards the central mesa.

artworks.title: Verde River, Apache Reservation, Arizona
artworks.medium: drypoint and softground etching in green on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image depicts an expansive landscape with a vast sky filled with billowing clouds. Mountains are visible on the horizon, below which are clusters of trees. In the foreground, there are cacti and desert flora on sandy terrain, with one tall cactus prominent on the right side. The brushstrokes show detailed texture of clouds and vegetation. The color palette is monochrome with greys and blacks.

artworks.title: Verde River, Arizona
artworks.medium: drypoint and softground etching in green on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a vast sky dominating the upper half. The horizon is low, with treetops and distant mountains underneath dramatic clouds. The foreground shows a desert terrain with cacti and shrubs leading towards a river or body of water. The artwork appears to be an engraving or etching with fine lines and subtle gradations. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing shades of gray to highlight detail and contrast between light and dark areas.

artworks.title: Dunes near Palm Springs, California (no.2)
artworks.medium: drypoint in brownish-black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with sandy dunes in the foreground leading to distant mountains. The horizon is high in the composition, emphasizing the desert's expanse in the lower half. The dunes have soft curves and delicate pencil strokes for texture. Mountains in the distance are drawn with slightly more defined strokes. The color palette is subdued, with shades of gray and beige. Sparse desert vegetation is scattered throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Harlech Castle, Wales
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a castle towering in the distance above a landscape with mountains in the sky. In the foreground, there is a house surrounded by trees, and the painting style includes intricate brushstrokes or pen lines for shading and foliage details. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on light and dark contrasts to create depth.

artworks.title: Sketch of Florence
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint, featuring buildings, bridges, and natural elements in a monochromatic palette. There are detailed linework and brushstrokes to distinguish the various elements like trees, foliage, bridges, and architectural structures. The composition leads the eye across the landscape, showcasing the city on both sides of a river, with distant structures against a lighter horizon. The horizon is subtly depicted with faint lines hinting at distant hills or land, creating a balanced interplay of detail and open space in the scene.

artworks.title: Evening, Arizona
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The landscape features a desert viewpoint with sparse vegetation. Tall yucca trees stand on sandy terrain, surrounded by low shrubs and plants. Mountains define the horizon, with fluffy clouds filling the sky. The artist uses fine brushstrokes to depict textures in the clouds and desert. The color palette is primarily gray, accentuating the landscape's details and textures.

artworks.title: A Fantastic Vase
artworks.medium: pen and brownish black  ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a large ornate urn or vase with sculptural figures around its rim. The color palette is primarily brown and black, with ink and wash techniques used for shading. The urn is centered in the composition, with the base at the bottom third and the figures encircling the upper rim. The background is plain, highlighting the detailed sketching of the urn and figures.

artworks.title: Three Studies of Hands Clasped in Prayer
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on  reddish-brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a detailed drawing of hands in various positions, focusing on the upper half of the hands and forearms. One pair of hands has interlacing fingers, while another pair is clasped together. The hands are carefully drawn with shading and contours to depict natural lines, creases, and skin textures. There are no facial features, hair, or clothing shown. The background is a neutral, lightly textured surface. There are no visible objects held by the hands, and the focus is solely on the hand positions.

artworks.title: A Capriccio of Ruins by the Lagoon
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash  on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a vertical landscape seen from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is suggested by a horizontal line just below the center, where the faint outline of water and possibly a sail can be seen. Close to us, there is a sketchy formation of lines and patches resembling natural and architectural elements, such as trees and ruins with arches, using loose and expressive brushstrokes typical of a quick ink and wash drawing. The color palette is subtle, mainly consisting of soft browns and muted creams, creating a gentle sepia tone throughout the piece. The overall composition is framed by a thin margin.
